business_problem: Idaho Forest Group needed a more reliable and less labor-intensive way to forecast cash flow, production and inventory because spreadsheet-based planning consumed huge amounts of finance time and made it hard to react to market volatility and mill disruptions.
solution_summary: Idaho Forest Group adopted ActionKPI's Integrated Profitability Solution powered by IBM Planning Analytics to centralize forecasting across balance sheet, income statement and cashflow reporting. The platform replaced spreadsheet-heavy monthly work with a rolling 24-month model fed by product, pricing, sales, inventory and production data from six systems. Mill supervisors can now generate daily production forecasts that feed directly into the finance forecast queue, while finance teams drill into revenue, customer demand, log deliveries, utilities, CAPEX and headcount through dashboards instead of rebuilding formulas manually. IBM Planning Analytics acts as the calculation engine underneath the partner framework, while comments and interfaces make the system usable beyond the core FP&A team. The result is a planning environment that connects mill operations with executive reporting, creating a single source of truth instead of disconnected Excel workbooks.

solution_components.name: IBM Planning Analytics
solution_components.role: Provides the core modeling and calculation engine for rolling forecasts, analysis and dashboards across IFG's operations.

data_flow: Sales, pricing, inventory, production, utility, CAPEX and headcount data flow into the Planning Analytics-driven profitability solution, where rolling forecasts are calculated and then surfaced to mill supervisors, finance teams, owners and the board through reports and dashboards.
business_outcome: IFG dramatically reduced finance effort, shortened planning cycles, improved inventory and production visibility, and enabled faster, more data-driven decisions across mills and corporate operations.
